title: Fiber: dry grass in the woods clearing
about: QA round ("fiber is too hard to get"). Spring 6, 10:00 in the woods clearing with three dry-grass bundles (fiber, golden ring like any wild good) and a wild leek. Each bundle gives 3 fiber and counts as one pickup. Open Menu > Make: a recipe short of fiber says where it comes from ("3 Fiber: cut weeds, or at Mara's").
